items.headline: Coastal Flood Warning issued November 25 at 8:53AM PST until November 26 at 12:00PM PST by NWS Los Angeles/Oxnard CA
items.description:
* WHAT...For the Coastal Flood Warning, significant coastal
flooding expected. For the High Surf Warning, large damaging
breaking waves of 8 to 15 feet with dangerous rip currents.

* WHERE...Ventura County Beaches.

* WHEN...Until noon PST Thursday.

* IMPACTS...Damaging flooding of sea water is likely over some
vulnerable low-lying coastal areas, especially around the time
of high tide, including over beaches (especially from Faria
Beach to Silver Strand Beach), roads, and structures.
Significant beach erosion is expected. Powerful waves and
strong rip currents will pose an exceptional risk of ocean
drowning and damage to coastal structures like piers
(including Ventura Pier) and jetties. Large breaking waves can
cause injury, wash people off beaches and rocks, and capsize
small boats near shore. Large breaking waves may impact
Ventura and Channel Islands Harbors. Extremely high tides may
cause dock damage and seawater spillage over low lying areas
inside of harbor areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Extremely high tides of 8.0-8.2 feet will
likely peak between 8 AM and 11 AM. Coastal Flood and High Surf
Advisories are likely to follow the expiration of the respective
warnings.
items.instruction:
Stay off of beaches and coastal walkways, roads, and structures.
Do NOT drive around barricades or through water of unknown depth.

Everyone should remain out of the water due to life-threatening
surf conditions. Stay off of jetties, piers, and other water side
infrastructure.

items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued November 25 at 8:28AM PST until November 26 at 3:00PM PST by NWS Los Angeles/Oxnard CA
items.description:
* WHAT...Hazardous sea conditions.

* WHERE...East Santa Barbara Channel from Pt. Conception to Pt.
Mugu CA including Santa Cruz Island.

* WHEN...Until 3 PM PST Thursday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...See the Coastal Waters Forecast (CWFLOX)
for more.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
